formula: agricultural water = irrigated crop-land activity * cluster/mode AGRWATPHL coefficient
cluster coefficient = arithmetic mean of retained GAEZ raster values assigned to each cluster, with documented nearest-covered-cell fill for missing island pixels
output_value: geospatial/summary_stats cluster means and converted clewsy coefficients

formula: demand_y = production_2020 * population_index_y; population_index_y = interpolated SSP2 population_y / SSP2 population_2020 after joining five-year observations to an annual 2015-2053 left index; 2051-2053 consequently forward-fill the 2050 value
input_values: 2020 crop production anchor;exact SSP2 workbook row

formula: select RCP, CON, MZE, TOM, SGC, BAN, RUB and CAS at AWC 200 mm/m; high input = HadGEM2-ES/RCP4.5/2011-2040; low input = CRUTS32/Historical/1981-2010; cross three metrics with irrigation and rain-fed modes
input_values: six GAEZ catalogue tables;8 high-input proxies;7 low-input proxies
output_value: 90 crop-raster records plus 2 bundled base rasters

formula: join data!A1373:Y1373 five-year population values to annual years 2015-2053; interpolate; select 2020-2053; divide each value by the 2020 value
source land activity * parallel output ratio 1 = matching ENV_LAND stock use
sum of 24 crop-land option activities * parallel output ratio 1
sum AnnualTechnologyEmission over technologies by region, emission and year
